title: Ralph McQuarrie
description: Ralph McQuarrie's initial paintings brought George Lucas' words to life, helping convince Twentieth Century-Fox to make STAR WARS. The 65-year-old illustrator says, "l feel very privileged to be 'Ralph McQuarrie, the Star Wars artist.' It was the best work I ever did—and the most fun." His production painting from THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACKS shows the epochal battle between Darth Vader and Luke Skywalker— father and son.
